2 · Paste the post copy

"It's hard to look at that and not call this rushed," Sen. Cathy Giessel said of DNR's Alaska LNG lease decision.

UPDATE. DNR approved a 50-year North Slope data center lease and decided to convey about 6,800 acres near Houston to AIDEA. The third is Alaska LNG's 800-mile gas line. Its comments close at 5:00 p.m. November 25th.

DNR proposes converting the line's two conditional leases into full leases. Per DNR, that is not a permit to build. Seven conditions stay as later gates.

Hearings run virtually November 23rd and in Anchorage November 24th. A decision could come before the December 7th handoff.

The three files, the hearing in quotes, the seven conditions, Houston at true scale and every window on one calendar are all here.

If conversion is not a permit to build, what do investors gain from having it before December 7th?

#AlaskaLNG #AlaskaDNR #AlaskaLand

3 · Post, then paste this as the FIRST comment (within a minute)

Shipped at 8.08 against the 7.7 cap threshold (5 of 5 rounds); base threshold 8.3. Art 6.5. PDF over the 25 MB rubric band. 02 sheet labels low contrast on paper tooth. Round 5 changes to 06, 07, 10 were not re-seen by a critic.
This story updates No.111 (Houston, ADL 234762) and No.112 (STAK, ADL 422741) and adds the Alaska LNG lease conversion (ADL 421296 and ADL 421297), which no earlier deck covered. The two scanned primaries, DNR's 17-page proposed decision and the Mat-Su Borough's two-page letter, have no text layer, so the showrunner read them as page images. No fetched page links the gas line to data centers, so the deck never makes that link and treats the three files as one department's decisions on one calendar. Effort ran at medium for this run even though .claude/settings.json carries high.
